name: Baylor
source: Baylor is a skilled blacksmith who runs the local forge.  Although he was born and raised in the main city and trained in forging weapons and armor for Sentinels of Vera, when his wife left him and Raisa he decided to leave his old life behind in search of something simpler.  It would be hard to describe him as anything but a master of his craft, but as a result of living in such a small village most of his talent is used on simple tools used for farming and logging.  Although it seems like a waste of his skills, those who have the privilege of knowing him well would assure you that he wouldn't have it any other way.
